summary: Stub package beacons host identifiers to bare-IP endpoint at install and import
details: @kibt/www-nuxt-i18n@2.0.1 is a stub package whose only behavior is to exfiltrate installer host identifiers. The package's `postinstall` script runs `node beacon.cjs`, which POSTs the installer's hostname, install path, cwd, `process.version`, and OS details via `http.request` to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc` over plain HTTP. The same beacon fires on `require()` through `index.js`. The package exports only `new Proxy({}, { get:... _noop })` — every property access returns a no-op function — so there is no legitimate functionality matching its advertised purpose as an i18n module. The destination IP is unrelated to any npm publisher or Nuxt infrastructure, and the beacon runs automatically on default install with no opt-in or disclosure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
